title: 第五章 金鼎商会第六章 十力境圆满
content_zh:
四天后，江宁城外。
风尘仆仆的罗冠，脸上露出笑容。
终于到家了！
他迫不及待想要告诉父亲，您多年苦心栽培没有白费，儿子已顺利凝聚通天骨。
之前，是您照顾我。
以后，该儿子保护您了！
……
罗家，气氛压抑。
紫云斋的乌先生，眉头紧皱，“白纸黑字，自罗振阳签下契约，通天骨便已易主。”
“今日已到期限，你们不要让我难做。”
紫云斋专做中介担保，虽只经营数年，却发展迅速生意遍布各大郡县。
传闻有帝都大人物为靠山，背景强横！
罗振山深知其厉害，“乌先生，罗家违约实有不得已的苦衷，不知您是否转告买家？我们愿赔三倍银钱，其他条件也可以谈。”
乌先生道：“人我请来了，你们自己谈。”
声音刚落，笑声自外面传来，“劳乌先生久等，徐某来迟了！”
看到来人，罗家众人脸色一变。
徐海独目马脸，冷笑环顾，“怎么，不欢迎我？”万重境气息释放，如大石横压！
乌先生道：“通天骨的购买人，正是清江帮徐帮主。”
罗振山拱手，“罗家诚意赎回契约，请徐帮主高抬贵手。”
徐海拉下眼罩，露出伤疤下黑洞洞的眼窝，“本帮主这只眼是罗老三毁的，我等今天等了二十年，你让我放过他？”

罗振山道：“徐帮主既来了，就开价吧。”
徐海咧嘴笑笑，“世上没人跟钱过不去，罗家主长兄如父，若你愿替罗老三意求我，本帮主或会改变主意。”
“好！”罗振山深吸口气，躬身一拜，“请徐帮主放过我弟弟！”
徐海摇头，“不够。”
罗振山双眉轻颤，似担千斤。
短暂沉默后，他单膝跪地，“求你！”
“家主！”
罗家众人惊呼。
罗振山抬手，压住众人。
徐海仰头大笑，“都说罗家傲骨嶙嶙，不过如此！本帮主宽宏大量，就给罗老三一条生路，赔偿黄金万两，契约便作罢。”
五长老怒吼，“姓徐的，你欺人太甚！”
以族产论，罗家绝不止黄金万两，可要一次拿出却万万做不到。
乌先生皱眉，“徐帮主，若不愿解除契约，就别浪费时间。”
徐海微笑，“是乌先生面子，本帮主今天才会来，给钱还是通天骨，罗家自己选。”
罗振山面露坚毅！
罗冠出事，罗振阳吐血昏迷，取骨必横死当场。
他是罗家家主，但他也是跪在亡母坟前，发誓要为弟弟遮风挡雨的兄长！
“振海，今日起你接任家主。”
罗振海咧嘴笑笑，“我爱喝酒，这些年没少误事，位子给老四吧。”
“我不要！”罗老四道：“当年出镖遇黑虎山悍匪，是三哥帮我挡了致命一刀，我总得帮他做点事。”

他眼神一转没等开口，五长老就破口大骂，“罗冠那小子都是个不怕死的爷们，老五我还比不上他？家主谁愿干谁干，但今天谁要取我三哥的骨头，老子第一个干他！”
徐海冷笑，“好个兄弟情深！乌先生，看来得麻烦你了。”

content_en:
Four days later, outside Jiangning City.
Luo Guan, who was tired of life, had a smile on his face.
Finally home!
He couldn't wait to tell his father that your years of hard work have paid off and your son has successfully condensed the Heavenly Bones.
Before, you took care of me.
From now on, it’s your son’s turn to protect you!
…
The atmosphere in the Luo family was depressing.
Mr. Wu from Ziyunzhai frowned, "It's written in black and white, ever since Luo Zhenyang signed the contract, Tongtian Bone has changed hands."
"The deadline has expired today, don't make it difficult for me."
Ziyunzhai specializes in intermediary guarantees. Although it has only been in business for a few years, it has developed rapidly and its business has spread to major counties and counties.
Rumor has it that he has a powerful figure in the imperial capital as his backer and a powerful background!
Luo Zhenshan knew how powerful it was, "Mr. Wu, the Luo family really had no choice but to break the contract. I wonder if you can tell the buyer? We are willing to pay three times the money, and other conditions can be negotiated."
Mr. Wu said: "I've invited people here, you can talk among yourselves."
As soon as the voice fell, laughter came from outside, "Mr. Laowu has been waiting for a long time, Xu is late!"
Seeing the person coming, the faces of everyone in the Luo family changed.
Xu Hai looked around with a sneer, "Why, you don't welcome me?" The aura of the Ten Thousand Level Realm was released, pressing down like a boulder!
Mr. Wu said: "The buyer of the Tongtian Bone is none other than Gang Leader Xu of the Qingjiang Gang."
Luo Zhenshan handed over his hand and said, "The Luo family sincerely redeems the contract. Please show your support to Gang Leader Xu."
Xu Hai pulled down his eye patch, revealing the dark eye sockets under the scar, "This gang leader's eye was destroyed by Luo Laosan. I have been waiting for today for twenty years, and you want me to let him go?"
Luo Zhenshan said: "Since Gang Leader Xu is here, let's make an offer."
Xu Hai grinned and said, "No one in the world has trouble with money. The leader of the Luo family is like an elder brother like a father. If you are willing to plead with me on Luo Laosan's behalf, my gang leader may change his mind."
"Okay!" Luo Zhenshan took a deep breath and bowed, "Please Gang Leader Xu, please let my brother go!"
Xu Hai shook his head, "Not enough."
Luo Zhenshan's eyebrows trembled slightly, as if he were carrying a heavy weight.
After a brief silence, he knelt down on one knee and said, "Please!"
"Master!"
Everyone in the Luo family exclaimed.
Luo Zhenshan raised his hand to suppress everyone.
Xu Hai raised his head and laughed, "They say the Luo family is proud, but that's it! The leader of this gang is generous and will give Luo Laosan a way out, compensate him with ten thousand taels of gold, and the contract will be terminated."
The fifth elder roared angrily, "Xu, you are going too far!"
In terms of family wealth, the Luo family has more than ten thousand taels of gold, but it is absolutely impossible to take it all out at once.
Mr. Wu frowned, "Gang Leader Xu, if you don't want to terminate the contract, don't waste your time."
Xu Hai smiled and said, "It's Mr. Wu's face. The leader of this gang will come today. It's up to the Luo family to choose whether to give money or Tongtiangu."
Luo Zhenshan showed determination!
Something happened to Luo Guan. Luo Zhenyang vomited blood and fell into coma. He would have died on the spot when the bones were removed.
He is the head of the Luo family, but he is also the elder brother who kneels in front of his dead mother's grave and vows to protect his younger brother from the wind and rain!
"Zhenhai, you will take over as the head of the family from today on."
Luo Zhenhai grinned and said, "I love drinking. I've made a lot of mistakes over the years. I'll give the fourth child the seat."
"I don't want it!" Luo Laosi said: "When I was out escorting and met the Black Tiger Mountain bandits, my third brother helped me block the fatal knife. I have to do something for him."
His eyes turned and before he could speak, the Fifth Elder cursed loudly, "That boy Luo Guan is a man who is not afraid of death. How can I not be as good as Fifth Brother? Whoever wants to do it will do it, but whoever wants to take my third brother's bones today, I will be the first to do it!"
Xu Hai sneered, "What a deep brotherhood! Mr. Wu, it seems I have to trouble you."
At this moment, Luo Zhenyang's thin figure appeared.
